articles.title: NASA Announces Eight New Commercial Satellite Data Agreements for Earth Observation
articles.summary: NASA's CSDA program expanded partnerships with seven commercial providers to acquire high-quality multispectral and SAR data. These agreements include Planet, Airbus, Vantor, Capella, ICEYE, MDA, and Umbra.
articles.significance: Significantly expands NASA's Earth observation data access through commercial partnerships

articles.title: Satellogic Unveils Merlin Constellation for Daily Global 1-Meter Resolution Earth Imaging
articles.summary: Satellogic announced Merlin, a new satellite constellation designed for daily global remapping at one-meter resolution. The first satellite launches October 2026 with full operational capability expected by early 2027.
articles.significance: Revolutionary persistent monitoring capability enabling continuous global intelligence infrastructure

articles.title: MicroVision Demonstrates Breakthrough Tri-Lidar Architecture for Advanced Perception
articles.summary: MicroVision successfully demonstrated its Tri-Lidar Architecture, integrating multiple specialized lidar sensors into a coordinated, software-defined platform. The technology improves cost efficiency and performance.
articles.significance: Breakthrough multi-sensor integration enabling enhanced real-world perception performance and scalability

articles.title: Deep Learning Pipeline Reconstructs Century of Urban Growth from Historical Imagery
articles.summary: Researchers developed an AI pipeline that reconstructs urban expansion from historical aerial imagery spanning 1920-2024. The method bridges century-scale domain gaps using attention-enhanced colorization and segmentation.
articles.significance: Enables unprecedented century-scale urban analysis and planning using historical aerial archives

articles.title: Shanghai University Develops LiDAR Breakthrough for Port Navigation Safety
articles.summary: Researchers developed a sophisticated point-cloud filtering algorithm for single-photon LiDAR systems, enhancing maritime environmental perception and navigation accuracy in ports.
articles.significance: Improves maritime navigation safety and autonomous vessel operations through enhanced LiDAR processing

articles.title: NASA Revives Next-Generation Eagle and Falcon Earth Observation Flagship Missions
articles.summary: NASA is proceeding with flagship Earth-observing satellites despite budget challenges. Eagle will map Earth's surface in 400+ wavelength channels while Falcon will study cloud-pollution interactions.
articles.significance: Major advancement in Earth science capabilities with molecular-level surface mapping and atmospheric monitoring
